race.comment: FEEL THE MOMENT (6) was in the money two runs ago then went well again last time over 2230m at this track, finishing 2.5 metres from the winner in second. Facing a tougher assignment but she is capable of running another bold race. PROHIBITED BID NZ (4) was successful last start by 2.5 metres at this track over 2230m after an encouraging minor placing the start before. Meets some better types this time but another big run is on the cards. TINEY (1) gets the ace draw and is a player after finishing third over 2230m at this track last time out. A good draw can see NO REMORSE (2) continue the consistent form..
